greeting.title: Hi all, I'm Catalin
greeting.subtitle: Caffeine-fueled code wizard, bug slayer, and budding cyber sentinel. I graduated in Computer Science from the University of Rome “Tor Vergata” in 2025 and recently completed a Master in Cyber Security at EPICODE Institute of Technology. I love turning spaghetti code into elegant algorithms, hunting down vulnerabilities, refactoring life one commit at a time, and experimenting until bugs (and exploits) beg for mercy. My hobbies include overthinking edge cases, arguing with semicolons, celebrating when console.log finally shows the truth, and probing networks just for fun. Life’s an open terminal — I’m here to leave meaningful commits, patch a few holes, and sprinkle a few Easter eggs along the way.
